## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m tools validate` passes
- [ ] `verification` is set honestly — `verified` only where a source states it
- [ ] Voltage ratings are equal to or above the original, never below
- [ ] `original_voltage_v` is recorded where a rating was upgraded
- [ ] No prices or stock levels added
- [ ] Written content is in English
